entries.scenario: Connected seller starts a ready order
entries.requiredOutcome: Order opens camera preview without a chooser, duplicate global action or separate scan.
entries.remainingEvidence: Observe first-use order selection on both phones; camera must not start recording automatically.

entries.requiredOutcome: Only genuinely required context; no marketplace, buyer invitation or invented imported facts required.
entries.remainingEvidence: Physical unconnected task plus direct API inspection of required fields and source attribution.

entries.scenario: One continuous recording on both phones
entries.requiredOutcome: One original per take; label read during recording; no restart, photo chore or end rescan.
verificationReferences: Existing CI Android attestation Kotlin job
entries.remainingEvidence: S24 Ultra AND A16 5G installed-candidate recording with a supported real label; inspect the actual encoded original and interruption flags.

entries.requiredOutcome: Every derivative remains linked to original/offset; preview and encoded-video observations are distinguished honestly.
entries.remainingEvidence: Native compile plus inspection of real encoded media/derived files; near-requested timestamps must never be reported as exact frame time.

entries.requiredOutcome: Exact current statement/context authorized once; server completion without a second finalize chore.
entries.remainingEvidence: Actual strong biometric signing and authoritative finalization on each installed phone. Browser behavior must not imply Android biometric authentication.

entries.requiredOutcome: No false saved/locked state; exact recovery once without duplicate evidence, declaration or Proof.
entries.remainingEvidence: Final-source transport-loss test plus installed-device response-loss run; compare stable IDs and receipts.

entries.requiredOutcome: Imported facts cannot be silently rewritten; raw/used snapshots remain attributable.
entries.remainingEvidence: Run direct and stale-client mutations against candidate schema; inspect denied writes and preserved source observations.

entries.requiredOutcome: Pre-capture correction allowed; material context change invalidates old challenge/signature.
entries.remainingEvidence: Candidate API confirmation of old-challenge rejection and fresh challenge acceptance; ensure capture-binding locks remain understandable.

entries.requiredOutcome: Root evidence immutable; later tracking/receipt/return supplements do not rewrite it.
entries.remainingEvidence: Candidate DB/storage mutation attempts and root-manifest comparison before/after later supplements.

entries.requiredOutcome: Shared capture/review; pending discoverable; no cross-order label/session/ownership leak.
entries.remainingEvidence: Three real controlled orders: one complete, one delayed upload, one mismatched label; preserve and resume legacy station journal separately.

entries.scenario: Connect, reconnect, sync and automatic-order setting
entries.requiredOutcome: One provider surface; OAuth outcome truthful; failed sync distinct from empty queue; ingestion idempotent; setting persisted.
entries.remainingEvidence: Live authorized provider/OAuth return, initial and later orders, off/on persistence and reconnect. Never mark a real marketplace order shipped for a UI test.

entries.scenario: Long activity history with repeated access
entries.requiredOutcome: Human milestones; truthful access-event grouping; all raw IDs/time/source retained.
entries.remainingEvidence: Inspect long authorized histories and grouped disclosure; confirm actor/link/30-minute UTC boundaries and no unique-person claim.

entries.requiredOutcome: Original aspect ratio, reachable controls, no giant blank shell; playback position survives navigation.
entries.remainingEvidence: Real portrait/landscape recordings, large text, narrow screen and tab/detail navigation; inspect actual playback/scroll positions.

entries.requiredOutcome: Recover original/journal where possible; prove playable bytes; no sole-original cleanup or false success.
entries.remainingEvidence: Force-stop each physical candidate at recording stop, journal write, upload, commit, declaration and finalization; compare exact original hash and receipt state.

entries.scenario: Tracking absent, pending, delayed, unsupported, moved
entries.requiredOutcome: Actual source state and last successful sync; no fake map/ETA/movement or waiting-for-carrier during outage.
entries.remainingEvidence: Candidate provider states and shared redaction cases; actual known tracking only, never fabricated carrier movement.

entries.requiredOutcome: Original account retains work; no cross-account originals, journals or credentials.
entries.remainingEvidence: Sign out/account switch with pending recordings on physical candidate; restore original user and inspect scoped recovery.

entries.scenario: Local cleanup and retained completed originals
entries.requiredOutcome: Zero pending is not zero files; cleanup requires applicable preservation/finalization receipts.
entries.remainingEvidence: Real browser/phone retained-byte counts and export; deny cleanup when receipts are absent/mismatched; inspect stage identity.

entries.scenario: Biometric cancel, lockout, unavailable, key invalidation
entries.requiredOutcome: Recording retained; no weak-auth fallback, forged declaration, stored samples or background prompt.
entries.remainingEvidence: Exercise cancellation, lockout, missing enrollment and key invalidation on both installed phones. Software mocks do not pass this gate.

entries.scenario: Multiple codes, mismatch and hostile payload
entries.requiredOutcome: Only supported tracking candidates attach; unresolved mismatches block declaration/finalization; no URL execution.
entries.remainingEvidence: Real glare/multiple-code labels and wrong-package conflict; validate immutable attributed exclusion and no silent order reassociation.

entries.requiredOutcome: Choice persists; action and success differ; neutral surfaces and readable status; no duplicate global action.
entries.remainingEvidence: Screen-by-screen review in all choices with fresh/default and existing preference; check static compatibility-token callers.

entries.scenario: TalkBack, 200% text, narrow viewport and keyboard
entries.requiredOutcome: Statement/action readable, reachable and meaningfully announced; contrast, focus and targets pass.
verificationReferences: Source token checks and component semantics are supporting evidence only
entries.remainingEvidence: Actual TalkBack, Android large text, browser 200% zoom/narrow viewport and keyboard traversal. Record clipping, focus, announcements and contrast measurements.

entries.scenario: Android Back, sheets, scrolling and video tabs
entries.requiredOutcome: Correct route/sheet behavior; no jitter loop; list/playback position retained; unsaved work kept.
entries.remainingEvidence: Gesture and three-button Back, Account after busy-state changes, batch queue, legacy journal, long list and player tab on both phones.

entries.scenario: Airplane mode, storage exhaustion, slow network
entries.requiredOutcome: Honest preflight, verified local recovery, bounded retries; no indefinite spinner or hidden failure.
entries.remainingEvidence: Physical network/storage boundaries and interrupted browser capture; disclose when media cannot be recovered.

entries.requiredOutcome: Same core facts, root/stage state, attribution and chronology; permissions enforced.
entries.remainingEvidence: Compare the same live candidate Proof on mobile/workspace/shared links with different scopes, old roots, later stages and redacted tracking.

entries.requiredOutcome: In-app/public initiation, authenticated confirmation/status, accurate retention and no owner-only sharing leaks.
entries.remainingEvidence: Verify actual public-host route/sign-in return and live persisted request; operational review/retention disclosure is reviewed separately from request receipt. Check terminal DECLINED/COMPLETED labels.

entries.scenario: Upgrade existing users and old Proofs
entries.requiredOutcome: Existing links/journals/preferences/connections/roots/return/grading remain usable.
entries.remainingEvidence: Actual signed upgrade over preceding installed release on both phones with pending ordinary/legacy-station/stage journals; compatible old client and additive migration checks.

candidateCommitReference: Exact commit recorded by candidate pull request and CI
